name: get_standup_data
description: Collect merge-request-based standup data from the linked GitLab or GitHub account. Returns one JSON object with today, previousDays, myMrs bucketed ready / blocked / draft / stale, reviews waiting on the user, and blockers carrying the error lines read from each failed pipeline job log.

arguments.name: provider
arguments.desc: Which linked account to read, by provider: github or gitlab. Only needed when both are linked.

arguments.name: host
arguments.desc: Which linked account to read, by host, e.g. github.com or gitlab.example.com. Only needed when several accounts of the same provider are linked.

arguments.name: lang
arguments.desc: Language for the date labels inside the returned JSON: en (default) or tr.

name: post_standup_note
description: Posts a finished standup note to the chat webhook (Slack, Discord or Google Chat) the user saved on the connect page. Sends a message other people will see, so only call it on a note the user has agreed to send.

arguments.name: text
arguments.desc: The note to post, as the chat should render it.

name: get_note_instructions
description: Returns the note-writing rules for turning get_standup_data output into a standup note: how to group the previous day by theme, derive today from open merge requests, and report a blocker from its job log.
